messages.translation: 流星索穿过了你的身体！

messages.english: You slip free of the bolas.
The bolas wraps around you and binds you in place!
messages.translation: 流星索缠住你，将你束缚在原地！

messages.english: The electricity makes your body seize.
Your body starts to freeze solid!
Your atemporal blood churns to no real effect.
messages.translation: 你的时间扭曲之血翻涌着，却没有产生实际效果。

messages.english: The spilling of your atemporal blood hastes your allies!
messages.translation: 涌出的时间扭曲之血使盟友获得疾速！

messages.english: A shower of butterflies erupts from you!
messages.translation: 一大群蝴蝶从你身上涌出！

messages.english: You emit a cloud of colourful smoke!
messages.translation: 你释放出一团彩色烟雾！

messages.english: Angry insects swarm out of your body to defend their hive!
messages.translation: 愤怒的昆虫从你体内涌出，保卫它们的巢穴！

messages.english: Your pain echoes through the poison around you!
messages.translation: 你的痛苦在周围的毒素中回荡！

messages.english: Your spilled blood starts moving with violent intent!
messages.translation: 你流出的鲜血开始怀着暴虐的意图蠕动！

messages.english: Your shape twists and changes as you die.
messages.translation: 死亡之际，你的身体扭曲变形。

messages.english: Your body crumbles into a pile of gold.
messages.translation: 你的身体崩解成一堆金币。

flood of jellies pours out from you
messages.translation: 大量胶怪从你身上涌出
一只胶怪从你身上冒出

messages.english: %s appreciates %s killing of a heretic priest.
The Orb lets out an agonising shriek!
messages.translation: 佐特宝珠发出一声凄厉的尖啸！

messages.english: The Orb lets out a furious burst of light!
messages.translation: 佐特宝珠迸发出狂怒的光芒！

messages.english: The lords of Pandemonium are not amused. Beware!
messages.translation: 魔窟的领主们很不高兴。小心！

messages.english: The Orb shrieks and becomes a dead weight against your magic!
messages.translation: 佐特宝珠尖啸着，化作抗拒你魔法的沉重死物！

messages.english: The Orb lets out a furious burst of light and becomes a dead weight against your magic!
messages.translation: 佐特宝珠迸发出狂怒的光芒，化作抗拒你魔法的沉重死物！

messages.english: The Orb shrieks as your magic touches it!
messages.translation: 你的魔法触及佐特宝珠时，它尖啸起来！

messages.english: The Orb lets out a furious burst of light as your magic touches it!
messages.translation: 你的魔法触及佐特宝珠时，它迸发出狂怒的光芒！

messages.english: Now pick up the Orb and get out of here!
messages.translation: 现在拿起佐特宝珠，离开这里！
